review_comment: The patch adds HTML escaping using cgi.escape for user-controlled input in email templates, creating '_forhtml' suffixed variables for safe usage. This properly addresses output encoding requirements for HTML contexts in email content. Ensure email templates consistently use the escaped variables and verify that cgi.escape provides adequate protection for all HTML contexts in the email templates.

The patch adds URL encoding for template variables used in URL contexts within emails. User-controlled input from HTTP requests flows through substitutions and receives proper URL encoding via urllib.quote() before template interpolation. This prevents URL injection when values are used in email hyperlinks. Ensure email templates consistently use _forurl variants only in URL contexts and _forhtml variants in HTML contexts to maintain proper context-aware encoding.

User-controlled request parameters are copied into email template substitutions without validation. While HTML escaping is applied to *_forhtml variables, ensure all template variables that could appear in email headers or body receive appropriate context-aware encoding for SMTP protocol. Apply proper escaping for email headers to prevent header injection and ensure MIME boundaries are properly handled when user input appears in email content.
